flavor.phonemic_palette: celtic (goidelic register: ri/tuath/flaith, Mac-/O- patronymics, initial consonant mutation (lenition c>ch, b>bh, t>th, d>dh), broad vs slender consonants, Dun-/Rath- forts, fine/cland kin-groups, root-initial stress, the cu/caur hound-champion ideal) / mesoamerican (mayan: the k'uhul-kah pyramid-cities, the ah-k'in temple-priesthood, the ch'ib'al lineages, the glottalized b'/t'/k'/tz', x = sh, the agentive aj- (he of) / ix- (she of), the -kah/-witz/-ha' place-suffixes, the Long-Count calendar and the stela-glyph)

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Tollraige — domineering martial aristocracy of the synthesis; conquest, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Tollraige are a vigorous martial aristocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Albawyn and Tollteca [Conquest Aristocracy (albawyn over tollteca)]. They prize conquest, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field light_infantry, chariots, berserkers. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
